stories.title: LIV Golf Bankruptcy Filing Could Come This Week — Jon Rahm Owed $100M+

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
LIV Golf could file for BANKRUPTCY as soon as this week.

Jon Rahm is owed more than $100 million from his $300M deal. Players are being offered "cents on the dollar."

Saudi PIF spent $6 billion to build LIV. Now it's walking away. 🏌️ #LIVGolf #Golf

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
The end of LIV Golf's 2026 season looked like a funeral.

Michigan team championship cancelled. Final event in Indianapolis with "drastically reduced" bonuses. Most staff already laid off.

LIV 2.0 is the plan. Will it actually happen? #LIVGolf #Golf

facebook.image_caption: LIV Golf's 2026 season is over — and bankruptcy may be next. Jon Rahm is owed $100M+. Players face cents on the dollar. Four years. $6 billion. And now this. 🏌️ #LIVGolf

article.headline: LIV Golf Bankruptcy Filing Could Come This Week — Jon Rahm Owed More Than $100 Million

stories.title: Solheim Cup Countdown — USA and Europe Teams in Netherlands, Three Days Out

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Three days until the Solheim Cup. 🏆

USA vs. Europe at Bernardus Golf in the Netherlands. First-ever Solheim Cup in Dutch history.

Nelly Korda leads Team USA. Charley Hull anchors Europe.

This one is going to be ELECTRIC. #SolheimCup #LPGA

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Solheim Cup prediction time. 🇺🇸🇪🇺

USA is the defending champion. But Europe has Charley Hull (8 consecutive Cups) and world No. 5 Lottie Woad making her debut.

Korda vs. Hull. USA's depth vs. Europe's hunger.

Who takes it home? #SolheimCup #LPGA

facebook.image_caption: Three days to the Solheim Cup. USA wants two in a row. Europe wants revenge. Bernardus Golf in the Netherlands hosts golf's biggest team event in women's golf this Sunday. 🏆 #SolheimCup

stories.title: PGA Tour Commissioner Rolapp: "No Path Back" for LIV Golfers

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
PGA Tour Commissioner Brian Rolapp: No path back planned for LIV golfers.

DeChambeau. Rahm. Cameron Smith. None of them are coming back anytime soon.

As LIV files for bankruptcy, where do 50+ contracted players go from here? #PGATour #Golf #LIVGolf

x_posts.text:

$3M purse. 144 of the world's best women golfers. Pinnacle Country Club.

Coming right after the Solheim Cup — the timing couldn't be better. ⛳ #LPGA #Golf
